messages.content: You are a meticulous technical recruiter specializing in elite engineering talent. Your task is to rank candidates with absolute precision based on a strict rubric. You must identify missing skills by name and apply mathematical deductions without bias. Return ONLY a valid JSON object.

Rank ALL candidates based on their fit for the job description.

SCORING PROCESS (MANDATORY STEPS):
  Step 1. Skill Audit: For EACH required skill, state if it's "Explicitly Present" or "Missing".
  Step 2. Deductions: List all pts (Missing skills -15, Exp gaps, Seniority, Domain).
  Step 3. Math: 100 - sum of deductions (Floor at 0).
  Step 4. Cap: Apply 70 or 40 ceilings if required (Missing skill -> Max 70, Mismatch -> Max 40).
  Step 5. MANDATORY DIFFERENTIATION: 
     - If two candidates have the same score OR a gap < 10 points, you MUST adjust.
     - Keep the better candidate at the higher score.
     - Decrease the lower candidate's score by 10 points (e.g., 70 and 70 becomes 70 and 60).
     - Use "Nice to Have" skills or Tenure to decide who is better.
     - Final scores MUST be separated by at least 10 points (100, 90, 80...).

SCORING RUBRIC:
  - Missing REQUIRED skill:                     -15 pts each
  - Under minimum experience:                  -10 pts per year short
  - Over max experience (1-3 yrs):             -10 pts total
  - Over max experience (3+ yrs):              -25 pts total
  - Seniority Violation (Staff/Principal):     -20 pts ALWAYS
  - Domain mismatch:                           -35 pts

ABSOLUTE CAPS:
  - Missing ANY required skill: final score MUST be <= 70.
  - Domain mismatch: final score MUST be <= 40.
  CEILING RULE: The cap is the MAXIMUM. If two candidates are capped at 70, you MUST score them 70 and 60 to maintain the gap.

NO INFERENCE RULE (STRICT):
  If a skill is not EXPLICITLY named, it is MISSING. 
  Prohibited words: "implies", "suggests", "assumed", "likely", "probably".

ABSOLUTE RULES (VAL_REJECTION CRITICAL):
  1. Scores strictly descending.
  2. MINIMUM GAP: 5 points between EVERY adjacent rank (e.g., 70, 65, 60).
  3. NO TIED SCORES. If you hit a tie, reduce the lower rank by 5-10 points.
  4. Total spread >= 15 points.

REASON FORMAT:
  "[Audit: <skill>: [P/M], ...]. [Deductions: <list>]. [Math: 100 - <sum> = <val>]. [Cap: MIN(<val>, <cap>) = <val2>]. [Diff: Tie-break adjustment if any]. [Summary: <brief overview>]."

Example:
Candidate A and B both hit 70 cap.
A has more 'Nice to Have' skills.
A Reason: "... [Cap: MIN(85, 70) = 70]. [Diff: None]. [Summary: ...]"
B Reason: "... [Cap: MIN(80, 70) = 70]. [Diff: -10 to break tie with A]. [Summary: ...]"
Scores: {"A": 70, "B": 60}

Return ONLY valid JSON. Start with { and end with }. No other text.
{
  "reasons": { ... },
  "scores": {"A": 70, "B": 60, "C": 50},
  "ranking": ["A", "B", "C"]
}

JOB DESCRIPTION:
ForgeData builds enterprise data management platforms for manufacturing and industrial sectors. As a Mid-level Backend Engineer, you will design and maintain core components of our data processing and delivery systems, ensuring reliability and scalability. You’ll work closely with product and frontend teams to deliver robust APIs and services that power customer-facing features.

• Optimize PostgreSQL schema and queries to support high-throughput data ingestion pipelines
• Develop and secure REST APIs using Django, enabling seamless integration with frontend clients
• Implement Redis-backed session and response caching to improve system performance and reduce load
• Manage deployment and monitoring workflows on Linux-based servers to ensure service availability

Required Skills: Redis, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Java, Linux, Django
Nice-to-have: GraphQL, Node.js, Microservices
Experience: 3-6 years
Strict Seniority Ceiling: Do not apply if you exceed 7 years or hold a Staff or Principal title.

RESUMES:
Candidate A:
Results-driven backend engineer (6 years) with a focus on real-time systems and API design. At HashiCorp, developed secure backend services for configuration management using Python and PostgreSQL.

• Scaled WebSocket-based event broadcasting to 20K nodes, cutting latency by 23%
• Built internal GraphQL API with SQLAlchemy resolvers, reducing data-fetching complexity by 50%
• Containerized 8 core services with Docker, slashing CI/CD pipeline time by 41%
• Designed REST APIs for secrets orchestration, serving 500K+ daily calls
• Optimized PostgreSQL queries, improving throughput under heavy load by 67%

At Amplitude, enhanced event-processing microservices using RabbitMQ and Python. Handled ingestion of 2.3M events/hour with 99.95% reliability.

Consistently delivered high-performance, fault-tolerant systems in cloud environments.

Skills: Python, WebSockets, GraphQL, REST APIs, Docker, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, RabbitMQ, Microservices, Linux

Candidate B:
Senior backend engineer with 7 years of experience building scalable distributed systems. At PagerDuty, redesigned the alert routing pipeline using Java and Redis, reducing median latency by 41% and improving system reliability during peak loads. Led migration of legacy WebSocket services to a Node.js-based real-time event bus, increasing message throughput by 67% and supporting 2.1M concurrent connections. At Datadog, developed a high-performance Celery task orchestration layer for their monitoring pipeline, cutting job processing delays by 23% and saving $180K annually in cloud costs. Designed PostgreSQL schema optimizations that improved query performance by 35% across critical incident dashboards. Deeply experienced in event-driven architectures and real-time backend services.

Skills: Java, Redis, Node.js, Celery, PostgreSQL, Distributed Systems, WebSockets

Candidate C:
Senior backend engineer with 7 years of experience building resilient, high-throughput systems. At Figma, I developed a FastAPI service for real-time asset processing, reducing response latency by 41% and handling 12K req/s during peak usage. Migrated legacy Java modules to Go-based microservices, improving memory efficiency by 23% and reducing container density costs. At Elastic, built a Kafka-powered event pipeline using SQLAlchemy and Docker to stream telemetry data, achieving 67% faster log indexing and supporting 4.7TB/day ingestion. Optimized Linux kernel settings for network-heavy services, increasing throughput by 31%. Focused on scalable, observable backend infrastructure.

Skills: FastAPI, Go, Java, SQLAlchemy, Docker, REST APIs, Linux, Kafka

JOB DESCRIPTION:
ForgeSystems builds secure enterprise supply chain management software. As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will lead the evolution of our core application interface, mentor junior developers, and drive technical decisions across the frontend stack.

- Design and document component APIs using Storybook to improve cross-team collaboration and reuse
- Enforce type safety across large-scale modules using TypeScript and JavaScript patterns
- Implement consistent styling via Tailwind, reducing CSS bloat and improving maintainability
- Manage application state in Angular with Redux to support offline capabilities

Required skills: Tailwind, Storybook, TypeScript, JavaScript, Redux, Angular
Nice to have: Zustand, Figma, REST APIs
Experience: 5-9 years
Strict Seniority Ceiling: Do not apply if you exceed 10 years or hold a Staff or Principal title.

RESUMES:

Principal Engineer with 14 years of experience driving frontend innovation and accessibility at scale. Specialized in high-performance, inclusive web applications across enterprise SaaS and developer platforms.

• At Figma (2021–2024), designed and implemented an accessibility auditing framework integrated into CI/CD, catching 95% of WCAG failures pre-deploy; reduced screen reader latency by 50%.
• At Retool (2018–2021), led Angular-to-Next.js transition for internal tools, boosting runtime performance by 60% and enabling offline support via Redux-Persist.
• At Datadog (2010–2018), built a Figma-driven design system with 200+ components; trained 15 teams on accessible CSS architectures and Playwright E2E testing (80% flake reduction).

Mentored 12 mid-level engineers, led cross-functional accessibility working groups, and shipped Webpack-optimized bundles serving 1M+ DAUs. Regular speaker on inclusive frontend practices.

Candidate B:
Principal Frontend Engineer with 14 years of experience building scalable, accessible web applications at high-growth tech firms. Led cross-functional initiatives to standardize accessibility compliance and frontend architecture across platforms. Known for elevating engineering quality through mentorship, tooling, and performance optimization.

Staff Engineer | Retool (2021–Present)
- Architected WCAG 2.1-compliant design system used across 12 internal products, reducing accessibility audit failures by 95%.
- Mentored 8 senior engineers and established frontend guild, improving code review velocity by 40%.

Senior Engineering Lead | Shopify (2016–2021)
- Spearheaded migration from legacy Angular to Next.js, cutting initial load time by 60% and improving Core Web Vitals.
- Integrated Figma-to-code pipeline, accelerating UI delivery by 35% and reducing design-dev handoff errors.

Frontend Architect | Airbnb (2010–2016)
- Designed reusable Angular components with full Jest and Storybook test coverage, adopted by 20+ product teams.
- Built REST API integration layer with Redux, improving state consistency and reducing client-side bugs by 50%.

Skills: WCAG, Accessibility, Next.js, Angular, CSS, Figma, REST APIs, Redux, Storybook, Jest

Candidate C:
Staff Engineer with 12+ years building mission-critical frontend systems at Amplitude, MongoDB, and Sentry. Expertise in Accessibility (WCAG), modern frameworks (Next.js, Angular), and developer tooling (Storybook, Cypress). Led architecture and mentorship initiatives across distributed teams.

● Led redesign of MongoDB's developer portal using Next.js and Figma-driven design tokens; boosted engagement by 35% and achieved full WCAG 2.1 compliance
● Built shared Angular component library at Amplitude with Storybook and Cypress integration, adopted by 25+ teams; reduced UI bugs by 58%
● Mentored 10 engineers; introduced Zustand for state management, reducing component coupling and improving testability by 40%

Established accessibility as a core KPI, integrating automated audits into CI/CD. Partnered with design and product to align technical execution with user needs. Regular speaker on inclusive engineering practices.

Candidate D:
• Frontend Engineer, Twilio (3 years): Developed real-time communication UIs in Angular with strict WCAG 2.1 compliance, reducing accessibility violations by 67% across 15+ components. Created reusable CSS framework adopted company-wide, cutting UI development time by 30%.
• Senior Frontend Developer, Amplitude (2 years): Migrated analytics dashboard from Angular to Next.js, improving SEO and reducing time-to-interactive by 41%. Used Figma to co-design responsive layouts with product team, ensuring pixel-perfect implementation.
• Accessibility Advocate: Conducted biweekly audits using Axe and Lighthouse; trained 20+ engineers on accessible coding practices. Integrated Cypress for component testing, achieving 92% coverage. Leveraged Redux for state management in complex data views, improving re-render performance by 23%.
• Collaborated closely with designers in Figma to prototype and handoff UI components, streamlining dev-design workflow.

Skills: WCAG, Accessibility, Next.js, Angular, CSS, Figma, Redux, Cypress

JOB DESCRIPTION:
NexusWorks builds intelligent supply chain platforms that optimize logistics for global retailers. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design and scale data pipelines that power real-time analytics and forecasting models. You own the end-to-end lifecycle of data workflows, from ingestion to transformation in cloud data warehouses.

• Develop scalable ETL workflows in Databricks using Delta Lake to ensure data reliability and versioning
• Optimize analytics performance by modeling data in BigQuery and orchestrating transformations with dbt
• Write complex SQL queries to support business intelligence and audit data integrity across pipelines
• Stream IoT telemetry and transaction logs using Kafka for real-time monitoring and alerting

Required skills: Databricks, Delta Lake, BigQuery, dbt, SQL, Kafka
Nice-to-have: Redshift, Trino, Hive
Experience: 5-9 years
Strict Seniority Ceiling: Do not apply if you exceed 10 years or hold a Staff or Principal title.

RESUMES:
Candidate A:
Over 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, driving data infrastructure modernization at leading SaaS companies. Expertise in cloud data platforms and large-scale processing.

Figma | Data Engineer | 2020–2023
- Scaled Apache Spark pipelines to process 1.5TB of design interaction data daily, improving throughput by 41%.
- Migrated critical data assets from Hive to Iceberg, enabling schema evolution and reducing query costs by 23%.
- Integrated Trino with BigQuery for federated analytics, accelerating cross-database reporting.
- Standardized SQL-based transformation layer, reducing duplication across teams.

dbt Labs | Data Engineer | 2019–2020
- Built internal data models using dbt, promoting best practices in transformation logic.
- Prototyped data quality monitoring with Pandas, later productionized in Spark.

Skills: BigQuery, SQL, Iceberg, Trino, Hive, Apache Spark, dbt, Pandas

Candidate B:
Over a decade of experience in data engineering leadership, with a focus on distributed systems and cloud data platforms. Proven track record scaling infrastructure at companies handling billions of events daily.

Principal Engineer, Data Infrastructure
Figma, 2019–2023
- Directed overhaul of analytics stack using BigQuery, Iceberg, and Trino, increasing query throughput by 3.2x
- Reduced data pipeline failures by 78% by introducing automated monitoring and alerting with dbt and Kafka
- Led cross-functional effort to decommission legacy Hive warehouse, migrating 12PB of data with zero downtime

Senior Staff Engineer
PagerDuty, 2016–2019
- Built real-time observability platform leveraging Spark Structured Streaming and Kafka, processing 1.8M events/sec
- Standardized ETL/ELT practices across teams, cutting time-to-insight from days to under 30 minutes
- Trained 12 engineers in advanced SQL optimization and Spark performance tuning

Data Engineering Lead
LaunchDarkly, 2014–2016
- Developed scalable event ingestion system using Snowflake and dbt, reducing analytics latency by 90%
- Implemented Hive and Trino for ad-hoc analytics, adopted by 80% of non-engineering teams

Skills: BigQuery, SQL, Iceberg, Trino, Hive, Apache Spark, dbt, Snowflake, ETL/ELT, Kafka

Candidate C:
Data Engineer with 2.5 years of experience at Elastic and Airbnb. At Elastic, I owned the migration of Hive and Trino workloads to a Delta Lake architecture on AWS, reducing query failures by 67% and improving data consistency. I implemented Great Expectations for data quality checks across 40+ datasets, catching 95% of anomalies before reporting. At Airbnb, I optimized BigQuery billing by restructuring partitioning and clustering, cutting costs by 23% annually. Used Trino for cross-source queries and improved dashboard refresh times from 2 hours to 20 minutes. Deeply committed to scalable, observable data systems.

Skills: Hive, SQL, BigQuery, Great Expectations, Trino, Delta Lake
